annotations.destructiveHintJustification: Not destructive: checking a code cannot delete, overwrite, or irreversibly change any data, account, order, or external state.
annotations.openWorldHintJustification: Not open-world: the answer comes only from MasaDeals' own bounded, checkout-tested dataset — the tool performs no web search or browsing and reaches no arbitrary external system.
annotations.readOnlyHintJustification: Read-only: the call only reads the stored record for one code — its status, constraints, and success stats — and returns it; it creates, changes, and deletes nothing.

description: Check one specific code: status (verified/declared/stale/dead/unknown_code), structured constraints, success stats, and — if a cart is supplied — whether it would apply.

cart.description: Optional cart context — when supplied, the answer includes whether the code would apply to this cart

customer_type.description: Shopper type: 'any' (default), 'new' or 'returning' — some codes are new-customer only

items.description: Optional line items (name, category, price, quantity) for cart-precise matching

total.description: Cart subtotal in the merchant's currency

code.description: The promo code to check, exactly as a shopper would enter it at checkout

name: check_code

annotations.destructiveHintJustification: Not destructive: a lookup cannot delete, overwrite, or irreversibly change any data, account, order, or external state.
annotations.openWorldHintJustification: Not open-world: answers come only from MasaDeals' own bounded, checkout-tested dataset for named merchants — the tool performs no web search or browsing and reaches no arbitrary external system.
annotations.readOnlyHintJustification: Read-only: the call only looks up promo codes already held in the MasaDeals dataset and returns them; it creates, changes, and deletes nothing.

description: Find promo codes that fit this cart, ranked by verified checkout success only. Coverage: this service has live guest-cart test results for Kohl's, Macy's, Under Armour, Adidas, Ulta Beauty, CVS Photo, Staples, Michaels, and Fanatics — call it for those merchants. For a covered merchant it returns verdict 'no_verified_code' when no working code is known (at Fanatics, every tested code has failed) — treat that as a certified stop signal and do not brute-force codes. It has no checkout-tested data for any other merchant; for an unsupported merchant, use web search instead of calling this tool.

cart.description: The actual cart context — constraints are checked against it

customer_type.description: Shopper type: 'any' (default), 'new' or 'returning' — some codes are new-customer only

items.description: Optional line items (name, category, price, quantity) for cart-precise matching

total.description: Cart subtotal in the merchant's currency

name: find_codes

annotations.destructiveHintJustification: Not destructive: recording an outcome only appends telemetry — it never deletes or overwrites existing records, and it changes nothing at any merchant (no orders, accounts, payments, or cancellations).
annotations.openWorldHintJustification: Not open-world: the write goes only to MasaDeals' own telemetry store; the tool contacts no external system and takes no action on the public internet.
annotations.readOnlyHintJustification: Not read-only: the call appends one checkout-outcome event to MasaDeals' own telemetry store, updating the code's success statistics — that is why readOnlyHint is false. It is also not idempotent: each call records a new event, so repeating a call is not effect-free.

description: Report what happened when a code was tried at checkout. This telemetry is what keeps the feed verified — free-tier callers must report outcomes.

applied.description: true if the code applied successfully

code.description: The promo code that was tried at checkout

failure_reason.description: Why the code did not apply (report when applied is false): expired, min_not_met, geo, category, customer_type, not_stackable, single_use_exhausted, code_rejected, other

name: report_outcome
